unit.sep: Observe,control,record across time,compare species and qualify causal explanations.
unit.careers: Illustrative plant-establishment/research practices;no agronomic treatment or growth-regulator qualification.
unit.focus: Growth/development,dormancy,actual germination-condition trials and types,primary/secondary growth,factors and context-dependent hormones.
unit.phenomenon: A fictional seed report treats swelling as new tissue,every ungerminated seed as dead,and every hormone as a universal accelerator.
unit.drivingQuestion: Which conditions,structures and records justify a plant-growth claim? KICD: Why is the concept of growth in plants important?
unit.storylineThread: Meaning → dormancy → plan → actualsetup → actualfollowup → actualtypes → growthorigins → factors → hormones → sourcecheck → audit → independent explanation.
unit.content: Concept of growth and development in plants; Seed dormancy; Conditions necessary for germination; Types of germination; Primary and secondary growth in plants; Role of growth hormones in plants
unit.coreCompetencies:
Communication and collaboration: as the learner shares information gathered on differences between plant growth and development.
Self-efficacy: as the learner works on practical activities to investigate epigeal and hypogeal germination.
Learning to learn: as the learner reflects on the experiments investigating conditions necessary for germination.
unit.values: Responsibility: Learner engages in assigned roles while working with others in the process of learning such as investigating conditions necessary for germination.
unit.pcis: Cyber security: as the learner observes online safety when searching for information on growth and development of plants.

sections.title: 1. Growth,development and dormancy
sections.prompt: Explain growth versus development and why initial seed swelling alone does not establish new tissue growth. Describe two possible dormancy causes and distinguish a dormant viable seed from a seed lacking suitable external conditions and a dead seed. State why species-specific dormancy-breaking guidance is necessary.

sections.title: 2. Germination conditions and types
sections.prompt: For FinalAcalculate condition percentages and give a justified comparison/limit. Propose two controls and a repeated/recorded check for an actual water-condition trial;state one condition not isolated here. For FinalBidentify epigeal/hypogeal cases and explain cotyledon/hypocotyl/epicotyl distinctions. State whether supplied descriptions prove you actually observed specimens.

sections.title: 3. Growth mechanisms,factors and hormones
sections.prompt: Distinguish typical primary length growth from secondary girth growth and label vascular-cambium xylem/phloem directions in a woody example. Explain two environmental/resource factors,including how germination differs from later photosynthetic growth. Give one accurate role each for auxin,gibberellins,cytokinins,ABAandethylene,with one context/interaction limit.

sections.title: 4. A useful concept and separate actual evidence
sections.prompt: Explain one specific benefit of understanding growth/development for a plant decision,with a condition/limit. Name separate actual individual observations needed to confirm your germination investigation and epigeal/hypogeal comparison. Explain why a long shoot or a written record alone is insufficient evidence of every claimed action.
